title: Layers can turn about X and Y and move in depth under a camera (2.5D model and renderer)
goal: Every layer gets Rotation X, Rotation Y and Depth, and every scene a camera with perspective, so flat layers can tilt, flip and move toward the viewer. All of it keys and eases like any other value and draws the same on the canvas, in playback and in export.
notes: User's words (2026-10-11): "I'm curious how difficult it would be to add 3d manipulation for text, objects, etc. Allowing us to create 3d animations and transitions which feel very native, rather than only focusing on 2d orientation of transitions" then, after the 2.5D vs true 3D answer: "let's try 2.5d then and maybe do that before title updates, so we can use it for the title updates". Scope is 2.5D: flat layers (text, pictures, shapes, groups, video clips) rotating about X and Y and moving in depth under a perspective camera, like Keynote and Apple Motion. NOT extruded 3D text, lighting, materials or 3D models. Four tasks in order: 2.5D design (mocks + card), 2.5D model and renderer, 2.5D controls on the canvas and in the panel, 3D transitions and title entrances. The title rework tasks (title-backgrounds-that-are-alive-auroras-energy, title-text-visibly-comes-in-and-every-built-in-t) are sequenced after these and should use the 3D moves. This is step 2 of 4.
acceptance: PhotonzCore first, tests first, pure and Codable with defaults so old documents open unchanged: Layer gains rotationX, rotationY (degrees) and depth (points toward the viewer), a 3D pivot (the existing pivot plus a depth offset), and keyable LayerMotion properties for each, eased with the shared EasingCurve list

A camera per scene or frame (perspective on or off, focal length or field of view, position) with sensible defaults (off means everything is flat exactly as today), keyable so a camera can push in or orbit slightly

Groups pass their 3D transform to their children (a group can flip as one, with children keeping their own tilt), with a documented choice of flattening vs preserving 3D through a group, matching Keynote/Motion where they agree

Rendering in PhotonzRender: each layer's 2D result is placed with a 4x4 perspective transform (CIPerspectiveTransform or a Metal warp), back faces hidden or shown per a setting, layers drawn in depth order within a 3D group, and optional depth of field (blur by distance from a focus depth) using the existing blur
Hit testing, selection outlines and snapping work on tilted layers (the selection outline follows the projected quad)
SVG/PNG export of a still and MP4 export of motion match the canvas, MEASURED pixel agreement at three moments of a flip
PERF, MEASURED with a note: a 1080p frame with 10 layers, 4 of them tilted and one with depth of field, renders in under 16 ms on this Mac
Unit tests: projection math, depth ordering, back face, key interpolation of rotation X/Y and depth, round trip of old documents
Audit under queue/audits/; anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar (queue/bin/follow-up-bar.md), and written into this task's log if it does not.

log.note: Camera card opened by the 2.5D design task: layers-can-turn-about-x-and-y-and-move-in-depth-where-does-the-camera-live (recommended A, camera settings on the frame, keyable). The model does not wait on the handle card. Mocks: docs/design/mocks/pages/video-depth.html (the cube move shows why Pivot depth is needed).

Adversarial pass before building: a Premiere/FCP editor expects Rotation X/Y rows under Transform and keys on the clip; Motion/Keynote users expect a flat card that flips with perspective and a camera angle. Mock assumption the app could not deliver: a camera to set (decision card open, built A: camera on the frame, keyable). Group semantics decided by Keynote/Motion/CSS agreement: flatten by default, keeps3D option for Motion's 3D group, top level always stack order so a title pushed back still draws over its clip (docs/design/space-3d.md).

Built: PhotonzCore/Space3D.swift (LayerTurn3D on Layer.turn3D, SceneCamera on document.camera, Affine3D/Projection3D/Homography, spaceChain/drawnQuad/drawnMap, depth order), 8 new MotionProperty cases with apply/format/starting, camera keys sampled in drawn(atTimeMS:) and moved(toMotionTimeMS:), posedForCanvas poses 3D + camera, hit test carries clicks back onto the plane (back faces hidden when asked), marquee, RenderDiff full when seen in space, magnification. Renderer: placedInSpace warps each finished picture with CIPerspectiveTransform after its 2D turn and before its shadow, DoF blur first, keeps3D groups pass through in depth order, flattened cards see an unmoved camera. App: selection outline and handles through drawnMap. SVG: turned layers fall back to their picture boxed by the projected quad.

Measured: canvas (renderInteractive) vs export render 0 of 120000 pixels differ at 300/600/900ms of a keyed flip; MP4 vs canvas mean red difference 1.08/0.70/0.88 levels, 0.6-1% edge pixels >48 off (compression); still SVG vs canvas mean 0.19/0.09/0.19 at 30/60/150 deg, edge pixels the same as any 2D picture fallback (688 for a 2D-turned glow card). PERF 1920x1080, 10 layers, 4 tilted, 1 out of focus: 5.5ms median, 8.2ms slowest over 30 frames (same layers flat, fresh renderer each frame: 6.8ms). Flat documents never enter the path: byte-identical render test.

Tests: Space3DTests (22, core), Space3DRenderTests (11), Space3DPerfTests, Space3DExportTests (MP4). Full Scripts/test.sh hung at 0% CPU in the known HEIF/Vision parks (folded into find-out-why-the-whole-test-run-hangs-in-the-mac); split run: core 11290 with 1 load-only timing red (LongTimelineCostTests 162ms vs 150, passes alone 3/3 in 47ms), render+media minus the slow readers 1214 with TitleSetFrames/MotionBlur 1080p checks at 16-17.7ms under load (alone: 2-10ms medians, pass), slow readers alone 72 pass. Walks: a-card-flips-in-3d-walk (new, Next defaults, 5 real captures), and property counts updated 14->18 and 19->23 in key-a-title-s-scale, properties-pane, properties-reset: all pass, plus a-turned-shape-keeps-its-turn-on-a-video, animate-a-property-list/find, an-editing-session, angle-field.

Left rough, not filed (below the bar or covered): drag sprites and layers-list thumbnails of a turned layer project about their own small canvas middle (cosmetic, covered when the controls task builds the canvas handles); a flattened group's buffer is its renderBounds, so a child tilted toward the camera can be cut at the group's edge; lens/zoom callout turned in 3D read the canvas flat; SVG of a document whose camera has moved still writes layers flat (no UI can move the camera yet; fold into the camera controls). 2.5D model and renderer shipped (5e4d6a6e): Layer.turn3D (Rotation X/Y, Depth, Pivot depth, back face), document camera (perspective, push, pan, focus, keys), GroupContent.keeps3D, 8 keyable MotionProperty values offered in Animate a property; renderer warps each layer onto its projected corners with depth of field and depth order; click, outline, handles, marquee and SVG use the same corners. Verified: 22 core + 11 render + perf + MP4 tests; canvas vs export 0 px differ, MP4 ~1 level mean, SVG 0.1-0.2 mean at three moments of a flip; 1080p/10 layers/4 tilted/1 DoF 5.5ms median; walk a-card-flips-in-3d-walk at Next defaults with 5 real captures.
